name: Earth, airless
$comment: THE NEGATIVE CONTROL for the sky (docs/66). Identical to worlds/earth in every respect except that it declares ZERO kilograms of air, which world_def::Atmosphere documents as the airless case. A sky that is genuinely in-scattered sunlight must vanish here and take the soft terminator with it; a sky that is painted will not notice. Load it with terra.html?world=earth-airless.
